# mighty.plumber

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/NovoNordisk-OpenSource/mighty.plumber/actions/workflows/check_and_co.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NovoNordisk-OpenSource/mighty.plumber/actions/workflows/check_and_co.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

Utilities to setup a [plumber](https://www.rplumber.io) API serving components
for the [mighty](https://novonordisk-opensource.github.io/mighty/) framework.

## Installation

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Install the development version from GitHub:
pak::pak("NovoNordisk-OpenSource/mighty.plumber")
```
